description: This file defines a mock actor class (MockClientActor) for testing purposes within a messaging service, implemented using the Akka actor framework. It handles various connection-related commands and simulates responses, facilitating testing of connection management.

classes.name: MockClientActor
classes.description: A mock Akka actor for simulating connectivity management commands for testing purposes, implementing connection creation, opening, modification, deletion, status retrieval, logging, and testing.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Constructs Props for creating a MockClientActor instance with an optional delegate ActorRef.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Logs a message indicating the actor has started.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Logs a message indicating the actor has stopped.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for various connection-related commands and queries, forwarding requests, and providing mock responses.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Helper method to forward messages to the delegate actor if present.
